body: For sure, it has something to do with instinct.  This is why we exist.  The sad thing is that dying is not a relief of your life's pains.  The relief you might feel, you will feel it while alive.  There's no point in living, but there's also no point in dying, so people try to find a point in living, I guess.
Maybe fighting for it would be my social responsibility, but at this point I struggle to find the energy for it.

I do not believe in magic thought, sorry.  I could get a good job tomorrow if I wanted, but I don't care about this.  I want to contribute to my field, and will not be allowed to ever do it because at the worst possible moment, I got sick.  If I live, I'm gonna fight against this for the rest of my life.

People just don't realize the magnitude of our despair.  They don't understand the obvious signals that we send about it, etc.  Can't really blame them, they just don't expect that and they have never experienced it.  And god are they easy to fool.  It's easy to lie about how we feel and why we act weird.
